description: This file defines function prototypes, a struct declaration, and documentation comment for a module that manages command-line options related to diff formats of merge commits in a version control context.

methods.name: diff_merges_config
methods.description: Configures diff merge options based on the provided string value.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress_m_parsing
methods.description: Suppresses certain parsing options related to merge commits.

methods.name: diff_merges_parse_opts
methods.description: Parses command-line options into the rev_info structure for diff merge configurations.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress
methods.description: Suppresses diff merges in the given revision info context.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_first_parent
methods.description: Sets the default diff merge behavior to consider only the first parent.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_dense_combined
methods.description: Sets the default diff merge mode to dense combined.

methods.name: diff_merges_set_dense_combined_if_unset
methods.description: Sets dense combined diff mode if it has not been set already.

methods.name: diff_merges_setup_revs
methods.description: Initializes or prepares revision info for diff merge operations.
